## Activity

During June 2022, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 355 photographic captures as part of its routine activity. The site continued to submit images for assessment throughout the month, with the recorded activity providing the basis for subsequent image-quality review and grading.

## Image quality

Of the 355 captures, 20 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.6. The result should continue to be monitored through routine quality assurance, particularly where image capture or patient positioning may affect the suitability of photographs for assessment. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

The grading outcome included 97 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 24. These results provide the current summary of grading activity for Harbour Eye Clinic during June 2022. Continued review of image quality and grading turnaround will support ongoing service monitoring and help identify any emerging operational issues.
